follow-up time: At least 4 months post-surgery for a subset of participants
cohort: 13 premenopausal, non-pregnant women with symptomatic c-section scars
finding: Clinical symptoms like postmenstrual spotting, dysmenorrhea, abdominal pain, and secondary sterility could be specific indicators for the diagnosis of uterine dehiscence after c-section, and microsurgical uterus reconstruction can improve these symptoms.
